title: OLD CLUB, NEW COLOURS: GUIMARAES WALKS BACK INTO ST JAMES' PARK
description:
Nine league goals last season, 31 in total for Newcastle. Now he's back in the other shirt.

Saturday, 5:30pm UK time: Arsenal at Newcastle. Bruno Guimaraes returns for a reported £75m. He started slowly at Arsenal, but he's first choice now, with goals against Sunderland and Leeds.

Arteta says he's still not there. Praise from Arteta clearly comes in instalments. Arsenal are five points clear, and Harvey Barnes says this is the match Newcastle need.

How should St James' Park greet him: applause or boos? Vote with your comment.
